connector.name: Mistral MCP
connector.registryDescription: Mistral AI MCP server: chat, OCR, Voxtral audio, Codestral FIM, vision, agents, batch.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mistral-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the swih account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
env.description: Mistral API key from https://console.mistral.ai/. The free Experiment tier provides 1B tokens/month.
